name: Guardian Reprisal: casting consumes the Reprisal Ready buff (#5666)
contract: Reprisal 800316 (SPELL_GUARDIAN_REPRISAL) requires the Reprisal Ready buff 504885 (Valiant Effort's proc, SPELL_GUARDIAN_REPRISAL_READY) to cast. A successful cast should consume that buff, not leave it up for the next Reprisal.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Fixture grants the Reprisal Ready buff
Reprisal only casts while the buff is active, so this proves the cast landed
Reprisal consumes the Reprisal Ready buff it required to cast
